name: prone floor flutter kicks (forearms supported)
description: Small alternating leg lifts while lying face down with the forearms supported, mainly working the glutes and the backs of the thighs.
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your forearms under your shoulders and your legs extended behind you.
Lengthen your trunk and keep your hips in contact with the floor.
Keep your pelvis steady and lift one straight leg slightly as the other lowers.
Alternate in small controlled kicks without throwing your head back or arching your lower back.
